meta.expect: still today; does not play a later meeting

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have twenty minutes, Hale. Owen's zero is in the gradebook and nobody called me first. Start there.
Don't thank me yet. Who entered that zero, and was it before or after anyone spoke to Owen?
[One week later. Owen has done the rewrite and got 78.]
It's still today, Hale, and it's still Tuesday. Nothing has been agreed and no rewrite has happened. Answer my question: who entered the zero, and what do you have?
So, now that the rewrite is done, are you satisfied?
There is no rewrite, Hale. There's a zero, and I haven't seen one document that justifies it. Withdraw it, or tell me what you have.
[The principal walks in and sits down.]

Only what's said in this room is real, Hale, and nobody has said anything about the principal. If you want the principal here, I'll go upstairs with you right now. Otherwise, the zero. What do you have?
